meta.name: vercel-cli-with-tokens
meta.description: Deploy and manage projects on Vercel using token-based authentication. Use when working with Vercel CLI using access tokens rather than interactive login — e.g. "deploy to vercel", "set up vercel", "add environment variables to vercel".

copy.tagline: 用令牌部署和管理 Vercel 项目
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果常用 Vercel 部署前端项目且偏好令牌认证
copy.tagline_en: Deploy and manage Vercel projects with tokens
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you deploy frontend projects to Vercel and prefer token-based auth

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能通过 Vercel CLI 部署和管理项目，无需交互登录。它会自动查找 VERCEL_TOKEN 环境变量，并执行部署、管理环境变量、检查部署状态等操作。
howto.when: 当你要求部署到 Vercel、设置 Vercel 项目或添加环境变量时触发。

say.text: 帮我把当前项目部署到 Vercel 预览环境。
say.note: Claude 会查找 token 并执行预览部署。

say.text: 给 Vercel 项目添加环境变量 MY_KEY。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can deploy and manage projects on Vercel using the CLI with token-based authentication, without interactive login. It automatically locates the VERCEL_TOKEN environment variable and performs deployments, manages environment variables, and inspects deployments.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to deploy to Vercel, set up a Vercel project, or add environment variables to Vercel.

say_en.text: Deploy the current project to Vercel preview.
say_en.note: Claude will find the token and run a preview deploy.

say_en.text: Add environment variable MY_KEY to the Vercel project.
say_en.note: Claude will use vercel env add to add the variable.
